new_entities.name: Pre-sleep casein protein intake
new_entities.description: Casein protein consumed before sleep to support overnight recovery.

new_entities.name: Overnight muscle protein synthesis
new_entities.description: The rate of muscle protein synthesis during overnight sleep.

edges.effect_quant: After endurance exercise, pre-sleep protein ingestion increased overnight myofibrillar protein synthesis from 0.047 ± 0.011 to 0.060 ± 0.014 %·h compared with placebo, and earlier resistance-exercise work showed a 31 to 37% higher overnight myofibrillar synthesis rate when exercise preceded pre-sleep casein.
edges.population: healthy young men recovering overnight from resistance or endurance exercise
edges.mechanism: Casein digests slowly and maintains amino acid availability during sleep, a period when overnight muscle protein synthesis is otherwise limited by falling substrate supply. When evening exercise has already sensitized muscle to feeding, that prolonged amino acid delivery seems especially effective.
edges.summary: This is one of the cleaner timing-specific protein edges. The mechanistic literature consistently shows that pre-sleep casein or protein feeding can raise overnight muscle protein synthesis, especially when an evening exercise bout precedes the feeding.
edges.caveats: Most direct evidence comes from short-term mechanistic studies in young men and uses relatively large protein doses. The edge is strong for overnight synthesis itself, but long-term hypertrophy still depends on total daily training and protein intake.

evidence.citation: SnijdersT et al 2016 Med Sci Sports Exerc
evidence.notes: Resistance Exercise Augments Postprandial Overnight Muscle Protein Synthesis Rates.

effect_quant.comparator: evening resistance exercise plus pre-sleep casein versus pre-sleep casein alone for overnight myofibrillar protein synthesis

evidence.notes: Pre-sleep Protein Ingestion Increases Mitochondrial Protein Synthesis Rates During Overnight Recovery from Endurance Exercise: A Randomized Controlled Trial.

effect_quant.comparator: protein before sleep versus placebo for overnight myofibrillar protein synthesis (%·h)

evidence.notes: Pre-Sleep Protein Ingestion to Improve the Skeletal Muscle Adaptive Response to Exercise Training.
